pattern: ^\[Win32App\]\[ReportingManager\] Applicability state for app with id: {GUID} has been updated\. Report delta: \{"{1,2}ApplicabilityState"{1,2}:\{"{1,2}OldValue"{1,2}:null,"{1,2}NewValue"{1,2}:"{1,2}ScriptRequirementRuleNotMet"{1,2}
description: Detects when an app's applicability state is set to ScriptRequirementRuleNotMet (PowerShell requirement script returned false). Quote-flexible since 2026-08-17: IME 1.104 serializes the report-delta JSON with single quotes ({"Key":...) where older versions logged doubled quotes ({""Key"":...) - every literal quote in the delta is matched as "{1,2} to cover both.
